title: On Characterizations of (Almost) Strictly Convex Functions
summary: In this paper, we unify and improve existing results on characterizing strict and almost stricty convex functions via subdifferential mapping, Moreau envelope, and proximal mappings. In particular, it is shown that if a convex function is subdifferentiable on its domain, then it is strictly convex if and only if its subdifferential is strictly monotone, equivalently, almost strictly monotone.
